description: Spacious two-bedroom apartment in Rincón’s Puntas neighborhood with direct access to a private home's pool deck. The lower-level unit features a full kitchen, dining and living areas, and a walk-in shower. The primary bedroom opens to the pool deck through French doors, and the second bedroom includes a queen and twin bed. Steps from surf breaks, beaches, and Rincón’s bars and restaurants—an ideal home base for a laid-back coastal stay.The spaceEscape to a spacious and inviting two-bedroom retreat in the heart of the Puntas neighborhood of Rincón, Puerto Rico, just steps from world-class surf breaks, beautiful beaches, and some of the area’s best bars and restaurants. This bright lower-level apartment of a private home opens directly onto the home’s pool deck, creating an easy indoor-outdoor flow that’s perfect for relaxing after a day in the sun. The unit features a full kitchen for preparing meals, a dedicated dining area, and a comfortable living room ideal for unwinding after a day in the sun. There is one full bathroom with a walk-in shower. The main bedroom includes a queen bed and French doors that open directly onto the pool deck, while the second bedroom offers a queen bed and an additional twin bed, making it well suited for couples, families, or small groups. description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceEscape to Casa Rosa, a modern ocean-view home with 3 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms in Rincón. This coastal town is known for its stunning sunsets and as a surfer's paradise with pristine beaches. This spacious retreat features a private infinity pool overlooking the Caribbean Ocean, perfect for relaxation. Casa Rosa offers a sustainable yet luxurious stay as it is equipped with solar panels, a water cistern, AC in each bedroom, a modern kitchen, and a gas grill. Enjoy the spacious living areas and trade winds that flow through the villa, enhancing the tropical ambiance. Whether you're soaking up the sun by the pool or exploring the beauty of Rincón, Casa Rosa provides the ideal setting for a memorable vacation.IMPORTANT NOTES: THERE ARE SECURITY CAMERAS ON SITE. ONE AT THE FRONT DOOR (MOTION SENSORED RING STYLE SECURITY CAMERA) AND ANOTHER FACING THE GARAGE DOORS (PLEASE NOTE THAT THE USE OF THE GARAGE TO PARK CARS I NOT INCLUDED WITH THE RENTAL - ONLY ACCESS THE GARAGE FROM THE LIVING ROOM)ADDITIONALLY, WHILE WE ALLOW FAMILIES AT THE UNIT, PLEASE MAKE SURE TO REVIEW THE PICTURES BEFOREHAND AS A SECURITY MEASURE - SPECIFICALLY THE AREAS AROUND THE POOL. LIVING AREAStep into the spacious living room, where 16 accordion doors open up to the pool deck, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. The bright and airy space is ideal for lounging and entertaining; a Bluetooth speaker is available as well as plenty of seating for everyone to gather comfortably. The living room includes half bathroom. Casa Rosa also includes a washer and dryer, ideal for extended stays. These are not visible in the pictures but they are located in the garage. This space does not have AC - open the doors and windows and the space will receive ample natural breeze. There are also ceiling fans. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSCasa Rosa features three large but minimalist bedrooms. The first two bedrooms are located on the top floor - each with its own king bed, AC unit and ensuite bathroom with shower, providing a luxurious retreat for guests. The largest room is located downstairs. Once you enter the room, you'll find door to the left which features a private bedroom with a king bed, AC, and ensuite bathroom with a shower. To the right, it includes a separate sleeping area which has a bunk bed with two twin beds, a bathroom with a tub, a sofa, kitchenette, AC, and 50” Smart TV. AIR CONDITIONING NOTE: PLEASE NOTE THAT WHILE THE AC’S ARE TURNED ON, MAKE SURE THAT THE BEDROOM DOORS ARE CLOSED AT ALL TIMES. LEAVING THE DOORS OPEN WITH THE AC ON WILL ONLY DAMAGE THE UNITS. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENThe well-equipped kitchen is a chef's delight, stocked with all the essential kitchen gadgets, gas stove, dishwasher and featuring a gas grill on the patio with an additional sink. Prepare home-cooked meals for your family and friends while enjoying the stunning views of the surrounding landscape.POOL AREA AND VIEWThe highlight of Casa Rosa is undoubtedly its private infinity pool, where you can cool off and unwind while taking in the breathtaking ocean views. Multiple decks around the house offer plenty of space for relaxation and privacy, making it the perfect spot to enjoy the tropical warm air and stunning sunsets.PLEASE DO NOTE THAT THE POOL IS NOT HEATED. The warm weather on the island takes care of that. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGThis property is located in Rincón and you will need a car to explore the island and all the amazing beaches - Domes, María, Sandy, and Tres Palmas are all located approximately 10 minutes away from Casa Rosa. Please note that the last 3 minutes of the drive is on a narrow road. Due to this, we strongly recommend arriving before it gets dark outside, which is typically between 6:00 pm - 7:00 pm. Casa Rosa has outdoor parking space for up to four (4) vehicles. **The garage is not available to park cars inside**LOCATIONNestled in a tranquil residential neighborhood, Casa Rosa offers a peaceful escape from the everyday hustle and bustle. Located in Rincón, known for its stunning sunsets and winter whale sightings, Casa Rosa is the perfect base for exploring this vibrant coastal town.Rincón is a mecca for surfers of all levels, with beaches like María's, Sandy, Tres Palmas, and Domes offering fantastic waves. Domes Beach hosts an annual international surfing competition and various beach festivals. Beginners can take lessons at local surf schools - there's one at Sandy at another one at María's Beach.Beyond surfing, Rincón offers plenty of water activities. Explore the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve, known for its beautiful corals and diverse marine life, ideal for snorkeling. In winter, you might even spot humpback whales.For a more relaxed experience, enjoy a sunset boat ride followed by a beachside dinner. Visit the Punta Higüero Lighthouse, a historic landmark offering panoramic views of the sea and Domes Beach.Food enthusiasts will delight in Rincón's culinary scene. Try Cowboy's Cantina for delicious cuts of meat and rodeo nights. Explore the variety of food trucks offering South American cuisine, vegan options, and refreshing drinks.Start your day with breakfast at The English Rose, known for its delightful food and stunning views. Don't miss out on the local favorites like Jack's Shack and Carta Buena for a taste of Rincón's diverse flavors.With its array of activities and dining options, Rincón promises an unforgettable vacation experience at Casa Rosa.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergent Please note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 8 adults/children at all times, including visitors.OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

description: This is the best value in Rincón for your own place. Keep it simple yet functional at this peaceful, well-located dwelling. It’s fully insulated (a novelty here) and air conditioned, located on our secure, gated grounds and a short walk to the beach or marina. The Ecobana has everything you need and nothing you don't. Bed, kitchen, bathroom, board racks and more. But not too much more. It's cozy-compact so it's better for a solo outdoorsy adventurer than a stay at homebody.The spaceIf you’re traveling solo for Rincon’s beaches, clear warm water, and world class surf, this might be the place. You’re not coming here to stay at our place. You’re coming here to soak up sun, surf, swim, and hang out at the beach. What you need is a clean, quiet, secure, stand-alone, air conditioned place to sleep, eat and chill, and to know that your belongings are safe while you’re off running amok. So we created the Ecobana. It’s the perfect spot for a tropical adventure traveler to come home to. It has everything you need and nothing you don’t. Kitchen-bathroom-bed, WiFi-fridge-AC, cooktop-ceiling fan-coffeemaker, Roku-surfrack-RO filtered water. There’s a very compact workspace to go with the WiFi, but if you need enterprise level speed for gaming or corporate videoconferencing, this is not the place for you. We average 30-50 megs down and about 10 up. This is not a resort experience, it’s much more utilitarian than that. (Though we do usually have a massage therapist on site.)About the name: Did you know that only a handful of homes in Puerto Rico are insulated, it’s usually quite warm here, and we have the highest electricity rates in all of America? One day we drove by a warehouse in Rincón that was being remodeled. The workers had piled a MOUNTAIN of scrap styrofoam blocks in the parking lot. “It’s all going to the dump,” they said. “We’ll take it off your hands!” we said. And with a borrowed truck, a hot wire cutter and a lot of work we did just that, insulating walls and ceilings in two wood framed homes plus the Ecobana.Besides the foam, we also repurposed extra materials from our other projects and had a great time doing it. As builders, there’s nothing like using up stored material. It’s like having a barbecue and hitting the hot dog-to-bun ratio exactly right. Spare copper pipes and floor flanges became furniture legs and curtain rods. Walls were sheathed with plywood offcuts and painted with colors left over from art murals. Leftover concrete and tile turned into kitchen and bathroom counters. We bent spare pvc pipe into surfboard racks. A solid mahogany slab, too small to make a cutting board, was the perfect size for a curio shelf. Everything done with an eye to sustainability. Which explains the name: Ecological Cabana, Ecobana! Other things to note: we offset our electricity use with solar power and Tesla Powerwall backup. In the event of a nighttime grid outage we require that no guests use air conditioning or anything that draws heavily on the battery. If the battery goes flat, the whole property is screwed. Turn off your fans and AC when you leave the Ecobana, it’s so well insulated it cools off in no time on your return. To maintain continuity during city water outages, we collect rainwater in backup cisterns. And as mentioned above, the Ecobana has reverse osmosis filtration installed so please don’t buy cases of plastic bottled water. Ours is better. Location: Superb. Located on a quiet residential street in a gated property with lush tropical landscaping. We have aloe vera and giant oregano. Our pineapple mango tree is awesome, (she and our passion fruit vines drop produce in season) and our star fruit trees are getting established. It’s a 4 minute walk to coffee and food carts, a 7 minute walk to the Balneario (the nearest beach), ten minutes to the marina or 15 minutes into the center of town with bars, restaurants and cultural happenings. There are cats that patrol the property but don’t feed them, we prefer them to be mousers. Thankfully we have no roosters -nor do the neighbors- so it’s quiet at night and early mornings. There are coqui frogs that will sing especially after a rain. And a big fat toad took up residence in the garden about 5 years ago so you may see him. Oh, and one hermit crab in a blue painted shell bumbles around sometimes. The Ecobana is the best value in Rincón. If it’s available, you should book it.

title: Pool · 2BR · 2 Min to Beach | Rincón
description: Casa Thais — 2BR apartment in central Rincón with private pool (exclusive to our guests), AC in both rooms, full kitchen, Smart TV, and private terrace.— Queen beds in each bedroom— Free parking & self check-in— 2 min drive to nearest beach— Town plaza, restaurants & supermarkets nearbyGood to know: this is a unit in a multi-family property. 1 bathroom. Beach is a short drive, not walkable. Rental car recommended.The spaceWelcome to Casa Thais, a dreamy retreat nestled within a multifamily residence offering several rental apartments. Our property greets you with two cozy bedrooms, both equipped with air conditioning and comfortable queen beds to ensure a restful stay.In the living room, a smart TV awaits you to enjoy your favorite programs, while the spacious dining area invites you to share special moments with loved ones. The fully equipped kitchen is ready for you to unleash your culinary creativity.Relax on the private terrace surrounded by lush vegetation, enjoying the privacy and security provided by our controlled access. As a guest of Casa Thais, you'll have exclusive access to our refreshing pool.Our strategic location places you just minutes away from the public square, pristine beaches, hospitals, supermarkets, and pharmacies, offering the perfect opportunity to explore all that Rincón has to offer.Immerse yourself in the authentic Rincón lifestyle at Casa Thais, where your comfort and enjoyment are our top priorities. We warmly welcome you to your home away from home!

title: Paradise Vista Penthouse, Oceanfront w/views
description: Views from this beach-ready oceanfront condo's patio and rooftop span from Sandy Beach to Aguadilla Bay. With 75 Mbps of Wifi, a building-wide generator, pool, and direct beach access, you have a full vacation within the property and ability to remote-work. AC and fans in every room. Surf breaks are just a short walk away, as well as several restaurants and bars. All local attractions are less than 10 minutes away. 1 designated parking space in a fully-gated property.The spaceParadise Vista offers exactly what the name says - great views. The rooftop dining and lounging areas are shaded and can be used comfortably any time of day. Perfect for 2-4 people, the interior and exterior layout gives each guest space to themselves and space to gather. Beds and baths have premium, cozy linens and towels. A smart TV is set up for entertainment or study. Two forms of internet allow for almost seamless wireless connection throughout the apartment. (Starlink for satellite connection.)Dining in is made easy with a kitchen stocked for those who like to cook, a rooftop grill, and indoor and outdoor dining space. A washer and dryer makes packing lighter a possibility.Take in views of the beach from the fourth floor and walk onto the beach at ground floor ...Guest accessEntire unit + shared poolOther things to noteThe buildings elevator can be very slow to unreliable. We recommend the stairs. Please store all beach equipment on the main level patio, not inside of the house. There is a shoe rack outside of the entry door that we invite you to use to help keep the floors sand-free and comfortable during your stay.

title: J2 Lush Gardens, Pool, Walk to Beach & Restaurants
description: The Jungle Unit 2 has a stylish look to this 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment w/ large fully stocked kitchen, private balcony. Listen to waves crash while you drink coffee in the morning on your private balcony or take a nap in your hammock. 2 yoga mats provided in each room. King beds, high end mattresses & bedding from Italy. Large pool with plenty of chaise lounge chairs, communal outdoor dining table for 10 people, Weber gas grill, WALK TO THE BEACH & restaurants, beach chairs, many extrasThe spaceThe Jungle has 5 unique and stylish rental units situated just a very short walk to Sandy beach. Spacious, airy, fabulously designed and stocked with everything for a short term or long term stay. Each unit has it's own private kitchen, in door dining, living room with Smart TV, excellent WIFI, private balcony with a bistro table and chairs and hammock. Air conditioning in all the bedrooms. Yoga mats are provided in each room. There is a shared Weber gas grill with gas provided. Also a large covered gazebo with a shared dining table that seats 10 people. In addition to that there is a communal outdoor lounge area and tiki bar. The pool is 15'x30' and has 6 chaise lounge chairs. We offer beach chairs, sun umbrellas and coolers for your use. Walking distance to Sandy Beach that has fantastic surfing and swimming areas, Casa Islena restaurant, Tamboo Restaurant, Kahuna Burger, Jakes Java, Jack Shack and Rogue Wave Convenience store. Road to Happiness board rentals and Mango Beach Shop are also in the neighborhood.You have one parking space available for your use.Jungle units 1&2 have ground level access with an elevated balcony as this property is built on a sloped terrain.This unit sleeps a MAXIMUM of 4 guestsGuest accessYou will be able to access your rental unit as well as the grill area, outdoor gazebo with dining, outdoor lounge area, and pool.Other things to noteThere are five rental units in total on the property.You have ONE parking space available for your use.Walk to surf at Parking Lot Beach (in front of Casa Islena)AC units are in the bedrooms only. The living room has doors and windows that open to let in the Caribbean breeze.This property has wifi with the highest speeds offered in Puerto Rico, Starlink satellite enables video calls, online gaming, streaming, and other high data rate activities exceeding the nations standard for broadband internet. Perfect for digital nomads who plan to work & play on Vacation.The property is equipped with Solar hot water.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

title: La Brisa Suite | Tropical Patio Retreat
description: La Brisa Suite is a peaceful room steps from Rincon’s most secluded beach. Entire Hotel- Recently refreshed with cozy bedding, enhanced Wi-Fi, and renewed attention to every detail, this intimate suite features a memory foam bed with luxurious linens, kitchenette, indoor bathroom, plus a large private outdoor patio with soaking tub, rainfall shower and hammock. Enjoy access to the pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, BBQ patio, and complimentary beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, and towels.The spaceLa Piña is a small boutique hotel located in Rincon, Puerto Rico, that comes complete with many amenities and is within walking distance to many activities, such as direct beach access, a swimming pool, snorkeling, fishing, a BBQ area, a private kitchenette, and an outdoor kitchen. There is a beautiful rooftop sunset deck with tabletop fire pits for those perfect evenings. Play a game of corn hole with your friends or just relax on a lounger and take in the ocean breeze. In addition, we are less than a 5-Tucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, Outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. Laundry room and laundry are free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. All kitchens have cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
